node.statement: Fix p in calU x B^{calH}_delta(J), put q=Pi_delta(p), and choose smooth charts alpha:W -> U subset R^n and beta:Z -> V subset R^n about p and q, shrinking W so Pi_delta(W) subset Z. By node 1.2 the coordinate map F=beta composed with Pi_delta composed with alpha^{-1} is smooth, and by node 1.3 its derivative at alpha(p) is invertible.
